_: (#R567) The UNESCO World Heritage layer (js/beta-overlays.js), its Atlas replies (js/atlas-controls.js) and its readout label (js/map-ui.js). de/ru/es are the arguments already written at the L(…)/LA(…) call sites and are copied here verbatim; fr, ko and zh-Hant are the new work. ⚠ TERMINOLOGY IS UNESCO'S OWN, not a literal rendering of the English: fr uses the Centre's wording («bien inscrit», «éléments constitutifs», «Liste du patrimoine mondial en péril»), ko uses 유네스코 한국위원회's («등재», «구성 자산», «위험에 처한 세계유산»), zh-Hant uses 《世界遺產名錄》/《瀕危世界遺產名錄》. ⚠ 「登錄」 IS AVOIDED IN zh ON PURPOSE — scripts/zh-hans.mjs converts it to 登录, which is «log in» in mainland usage; 「列入（名錄）」 is right in both orthographies. ⚠ Every {n} {s} {p} {d} {y} {q} {c} placeholder is substituted by .split().join() at the call site, so each must appear exactly as spelled here.
